acceptance.statement: Every test case in the EAP test files carries a Discharge Annotation naming the Scenario Identifiers it discharges, or is explicitly recorded as out-of-scope with a reason
acceptance.evidence: 131 test cases across the 21 EAP test files. 110 emit a Discharge Annotation (one record per execution in .verification/annotations.jsonl, sink truncated before the measuring run). The remaining 21 carry an in-file OUT OF SCOPE comment naming the reason; they are inventoried by class in docs/verification/annotation-coverage.json. 110 + 21 = 131, so no case is unaccounted for.
acceptance.deviation: 003 task 06 says '17 EAP test files'. The measured set is 21 — every path named in the task brief was verified to exist. The count in 003 is stale; reported rather than forced.

acceptance.statement: Annotating changes no assertion: pass count, file count and total expect() count unchanged from the pre-annotation baseline
acceptance.independentCheck: bun scripts/verification/assertion-fingerprint.ts --check → PASS, all 7 f001-* fingerprints match the committed baseline, no hash changed. docs/verification/assertion-fingerprints.json was read only, never written.
acceptance.limitation: Carried from task 12: matcher ARGUMENTS are outside the fingerprint, so it proves nothing was dropped, not that nothing was weakened. The unchanged whole-suite expect() total is the independent second leg.

acceptance.statement: Any scenario left with no annotating test is listed as a known gap rather than silently absent, and any test discharging a QA1-QA7 identifier is reported for task 08 rather than committed
acceptance.gaps: All 13 gap scenarios are recorded, each with a reason, in docs/verification/annotation-coverage.json. The 24 covers-partially-only scenarios are recorded separately with the specific unproven clause, since 003 §Section 2 forbids promoting them on partial links alone.
acceptance.deviation: The brief asks for the gaps to be recorded IN docs/verification/scenario-register.json. That is mechanically impossible without touching files task 06 may only read. `serializeRegister` (scripts/verification/register-scenarios.ts) emits a fixed key set and drops everything else, and register-scenarios.test.ts pins `serializeRegister(regenerated) === committedRaw()` byte for byte — so any gap field added to the register is erased on regeneration and fails that test. Widening the serializer means editing scripts/verification/* (off-limits) or weakening a test (forbidden). scenario-register.json is therefore left byte-unchanged and the ledger is committed as docs/verification/annotation-coverage.json, which is not any other task's declared scope path. Folding it back into the register is an architect decision for task 07.
acceptance.quarantine: Zero Traceability Links into EAP-QUAR-001..007 were committed. The sink holds zero records with a non-empty `declaredUntestable` field — the mechanical input task 08's gate consumes — so the gate can be enabled against this corpus with no pre-existing violation to resolve. Three families had candidate cases; all were reviewed and reported for task 08 rather than bound.

quarantineReportForTask08.verdict: NOT A VIOLATION — binding not committed. Each case asserts the destination status of an indirect recall dependent stays UNDECIDED (no status invented, lifecycle held short of `verified`). They keep QA2 open rather than resolving it.
NOT A VIOLATION — binding not committed. graph-core/test/eap-types.test.ts asserts the LegacyClaimStatus mapper THROWS with the deferral reason, pinning the ambiguity open.

NOT A VIOLATION — no case asserts a maximum batch size, page size or completion bound. Each forces RECALL_LIMITS.maxBatches to an explicit test value, checks only the REPORTING shape, and restores the original. Flagged so task 08 can re-check the reasoning rather than take it on trust.

lowConfidenceBindings.doubt: The scenario says 'two CONCURRENT transitions'. The two saves are issued sequentially; only the shared expected Sequence — the mechanism the scenario actually names — is exercised. Downgrade to covers-partially if a reviewer reads 'concurrent' as load-bearing.

lowConfidenceBindings.doubt: The test name is the scenario heading verbatim and the scar is queried after completion, but the second Then clause — 'no admitted record is erased or directly rewritten' — is not observed anywhere in the corpus.

lowConfidenceBindings.test: packages/graph-core/test/eap-lifecycle.test.ts :: 1. Should complete Relative Authority when full normative sequence succeeds in order
lowConfidenceBindings.doubt: 'receives Relative Authority ONLY within that Horizon' is not proven by this case; the aggregate is merely constructed against one HorizonId. The scoping half is EAP-HRZN-004's case, in a different file.

lowConfidenceBindings.test: packages/mcp-server/test/f001-retry5-concurrency-authz.test.ts :: getAuditLog applies an authorization projection filter
lowConfidenceBindings.doubt: 'without changing the append-only audit record' is inferred from the scoped principal still reading the full entry afterwards, rather than asserted against the durable rows directly.

lowConfidenceBindings.test: packages/mcp-server/test/f001-retry8-resume-index.test.ts :: re-driving a batch-cap-exhausted case finishes it and reports it as resumed
lowConfidenceBindings.doubt: 'the final affected set equals uninterrupted execution' is proven against the known closure (k1..k4) rather than against a separately executed uninterrupted run.

findings.detail: 003 task 06 states 17 EAP test files; the measured set is 21.

packages/graph-core/test/eap-types.test.ts imports createHorizonId, createSequence, validateSequenceAdvance, validateNegotiationSeed, validatePersistentDelta, validateOperatorApproval, requiresSingleUseAuthorization, isValidCapabilityClassification, EPISTEMIC_LIFECYCLE_STATES, isValidEpistemicLifecycleState, BOUNDARY_COMMANDS, isBoundaryCommand and createRefusal, and calls none of them. This is the direct cause of gaps EAP-VOBJ-005, EAP-VOBJ-006 and EAP-VOBJ-008, and of EAP-VOBJ-007 having only producing-side partial links. Closing those gaps is cheap and mostly means calling functions the file already imports.

EAP-SVCS-001, EAP-SVCS-002 and EAP-PERS-003 are exercised by commit-atomic.test.ts and tenant-isolation.test.ts, which lie outside the 21-file EAP corpus. They are gaps in the ANNOTATED set, not necessarily in the suite. Whether annotation extends to the changeset corpus is an architect decision.
scenario-register.json cannot hold gap records under the current serializer + byte-identity test. See acceptance 3's deviation note.

packages/client uses moduleResolution `nodenext`, so its two EAP test files must import the annotation surface with an explicit extension. `.js` made tsc follow into annotate.ts and typecheck it under client's stricter settings, producing 6 new errors (a [new-file] gate violation). The working form is the `.ts` extension (client and mcp-server both set allowImportingTsExtensions), which also required annotate.ts's own import of scripts/verification/register-scenarios to gain a `.ts` extension. graph-core uses `bundler` resolution and needs no extension. Net effect on the typecheck gate: PASS, frozen error set unchanged, client project total fell from 20 to 18 errors.
